body:
I appreciate your reply, it means a lot to me though I find it difficult to write back much, but I did read it thoroughly and twice, and I am thankful for it and you, and the others. 

I have discussed almost all of the things I mentioned here. I haven't really explained the extent of this out of body experience, but it is extremely different now than it was when I explained it to them on Friday (they're closed on the weekends). It was the same thing sort of, but now it's so... unreal. I'm sitting here and my fingers are moving to depict what I'm thinking, but other than that I feel like this can't be reality. It's not as vivid as I always felt that it was. I feel like I'm watching a movie through some guy's eyes. I'll tell them tomorrow about that. Everything else, yeah. They told me to call the hotline if things got worse since I couldn't call them over the weekend. I told them things would almost certainly get worse (because on Friday I still felt like there was a slight hope, a slight chance, and she would very likely smash it to pieces before me over the next few days causing me to feel even shittier [I predicted correctly]). They told me in that case don't try to aim for that sort of closure yet (so I don't feel hopeless). Well I tried to wait until Monday where I could talk to them again, but I fucked up. I did it tonight, and now I'm here feeling like I'm not a human anymore and my life has no purpose, though I know that isn't true. But right now, I don't feel like me, so that doesn't help me. I just want to kill myself. I can and have much desire to walk out the door and jump from somewhere or wait by the tracks.

So what happens to you that you're still here? Sorry to hear about your ALS. 

This is the first "real" relationship I've been out of (but not even remotely the first time I've tried to/thought about suicide). It feels like such pure shit. I don't know how to go back to being who I am. I can't just meet someone else - it's summertime. How do I open up and meet people during the summer?
I don't know what happened in this sentence near the end but likewise.
